Beginner.learningGoal: Throw and catch exceptions appropriately and validate input.
gotchas: throw ex; resets the stack trace; use throw;
Using exceptions for normal control flow
shapeHints: validating a new user's email and age

Intermediate.learningGoal: Design error handling for a service: custom exceptions, wrapping and Try-patterns.
gotchas: Losing the inner exception when wrapping
Exception filters (when) vs catching and rethrowing
goodSolutionShows: Custom exception with the inner exception preserved
shapeHints: a payment step that must surface the provider's error
a parser offering both Parse and TryParse

Advanced.learningGoal: Choose between exceptions and result types; handle aggregate and async exceptions.
gotchas: AggregateException from Task.WhenAll only surfaces the first on await
Result types that are ignored silently
Exceptions crossing thread or async boundaries
goodSolutionShows: All failures from parallel work reported
Clear rules for what is exceptional
shapeHints: validating a batch of imported users and reporting every problem
